name: Thundering Jade Cloud Serpent

sourcemore.n: Guild Glory of the Pandaria Raider

tip: Reins of the Thundering Jade Cloud Serpent
Use: Teaches you how to summon this mount.  This is a flying mount.  Requires Cloud Serpent Riding from the Order of the Cloud Serpent.
Summons and dismisses a rideable Thundering Jade Cloud Serpent.  This is a flying mount.  Requires Cloud Serpent Riding from the Order of the Cloud Serpent.
